'''The Hutt Haven''' was a dim and smoke-choked [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafe]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="KT" />

It was here where [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] agent, [[Kirtan Loor]] set up a meeting with [[Lawyer/Legends|lawyer]] [[Nawara Ven]] under the name [[Hes Glillto]]. He asked for immunity in exchange for proving [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu's]] [[Trial of Tycho Celchu|innocence]] and exposing all the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] agents operating on Coruscant.<ref name="KT" />
